description: Databricks Cluster Analysis Rules and Thresholds Configuration

utilization_categorization.description: Thresholds for categorizing cluster utilization based on max(CPU, Memory)

autoscaling_range_classification.description: Thresholds for classifying autoscaling range size (max_workers - min_workers)

network_thresholds.description: Percentile threshold for calculating high network traffic baseline
network_thresholds.note: 75th percentile used for both received and sent traffic (more sensitive to network-intensive workloads). Absolute threshold of 100,000 MB ensures very high traffic is always detected.

autoscaling_recommendations.description: Rules for generating autoscaling cluster recommendations based on range and utilization

narrow.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Idle cluster. Reduce to {min_w}-{new_max} or terminate if unused

moderate.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Idle cluster. Reduce to {min_w}-{new_max} (potential {savings_min}-{savings_max}% savings)

wide.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Idle cluster with wide range. Reduce to {min_w}-{new_max} or terminate (potential {savings_min}-{savings_max}% savings)

narrow.recommendation_template: HIGH: Low utilization. Consider reducing to {min_w}-{new_max} or review workload necessity

moderate.recommendation_template: HIGH: Low utilization. Reduce max to {new_max} ({min_w}-{new_max})

wide.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Low utilization with wide range. Reduce to {min_w}-{new_max} (potential {savings_min}-{savings_max}% savings)

narrow.recommendation_template: LOW: Under-utilized but narrow range is acceptable. Monitor or reduce max to {new_max}

moderate.recommendation_template: MEDIUM: Under-utilized. Consider reducing max to {new_max} ({min_w}-{new_max})

wide.recommendation_template: HIGH: Under-utilized with wide range. Reduce to {min_w}-{new_max} for better cost efficiency

narrow.recommendation_template: LOW: Well-configured. Optionally expand to {min_w}-{new_max} for more flexibility

moderate.recommendation_template: LOW: Well-configured and appropriately sized. No action needed

wide.recommendation_template: LOW: Well-utilized. Wide range provides good elasticity. No action needed

narrow.recommendation_template: HIGH: High utilization with narrow range. Increase to {min_w}-{new_max} to handle peaks

moderate.recommendation_template: HIGH: High utilization. Increase max to {new_max} ({min_w}-{new_max}) to prevent bottlenecks

wide.recommendation_template: MEDIUM: High utilization but wide range should handle peaks. Consider increasing to {min_w}-{new_max} if consistent

fixed_size_recommendations.description: Rules for generating fixed-size cluster recommendations based on worker count and utilization

single_worker.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Idle cluster. Terminate if unused or keep for on-demand dev work

small_cluster.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Idle. Reduce from {worker_count} to 1 worker ({savings}% savings) or terminate

large_cluster.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Idle. Reduce from {worker_count} to 1-2 workers OR enable autoscaling 1-2 ({savings_min}-{savings_max}% savings)

single_worker.recommendation_template: LOW: Light usage appropriate for dev/test. Keep as-is

up_to_4_workers.recommendation_template: HIGH: Low utilization. Reduce from {worker_count} to {target} workers ({savings}% savings)

5_to_8_workers.recommendation_template: HIGH: Over-provisioned. Reduce to {target} workers OR enable autoscaling 1-{as_max}

9_plus_workers.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Severely over-provisioned. Reduce to {target} workers OR enable autoscaling 2-{as_max}

up_to_3_workers.recommendation_template: LOW: Acceptable for small cluster. Consider autoscaling 1-{as_max} for cost flexibility

4_to_6_workers.recommendation_template: MEDIUM: Under-utilized. Reduce to {target} workers OR enable autoscaling {target}-{worker_count}

7_plus_workers.recommendation_template: HIGH: Under-utilized. Reduce from {worker_count} to {target} workers OR enable autoscaling {target}-{worker_count}

up_to_4_workers.recommendation_template: LOW: Optimal sizing for workload. No action needed

5_to_8_workers.recommendation_template: LOW: Well-sized. Optional: Enable autoscaling {as_min}-{as_max} for flexibility

9_plus_workers.recommendation_template: MEDIUM: Well-utilized. Consider autoscaling {as_min}-{as_max} to optimize costs during low-demand

single_worker.recommendation_template: HIGH: Under-provisioned. Add 1 worker (fixed 2) OR enable autoscaling 1-3

2_to_3_workers.recommendation_template: HIGH: Under-provisioned. Add 1 worker (fixed {target}) OR enable autoscaling {worker_count}-{as_max}

4_to_6_workers.recommendation_template: HIGH: Under-provisioned. Add {add_nodes} workers (fixed {target}) OR enable autoscaling {worker_count}-{as_max}

7_to_10_workers.recommendation_template: HIGH: Under-provisioned. Add {add_nodes} workers (fixed {target}) OR enable autoscaling {worker_count}-{as_max}

11_plus_workers.recommendation_template: CRITICAL: Under-provisioned. Add {add_nodes} workers (fixed {target}) OR enable autoscaling {worker_count}-{as_max}

recommendation_severity_levels.description: Severity levels used in recommendations (informational only, not used for priority column)
recommendation_severity_levels.note: These keywords appear in recommendation text but do not generate separate priority column

vm_size_recommendations.description: VM sizing recommendations based on cluster utilization category

High Utilization.primary: SCALE UP - Increase VM size by 50%

vm_series_guidance.description: Azure VM series-specific recommendations based on workload characteristics
vm_series_guidance.F: VM: Compute-optimized (F-series) for streaming & full-scan ELT
vm_series_guidance.D: VM: General purpose (D-series) for standard workloads

vm_size_recommendations.fallback_recommendation: Review utilization patterns and adjust VM size if needed
